reviews.text:
its gentle on my skin, i dont need a lots of product to clean my face and i do like lots of other products from this brand. i only started to use it like a week ago or so, but i used it at morning and night, and it was good both cases. be careful, it contains fragrances, so if youre semsitive for thet, its not your product!

please like, so i can have some extra points ❤️
reviews.zh:
佢對我皮膚好温和，唔需要太多產品就可以清潔面部，而且我好鍾意呢個品牌嘅其他產品。我用咗大約一個星期，早晚都用，兩個時段都好好。注意，佢含有香料，所以如果你對香料敏感，就唔係你嘅產品！

請撳 like，等我可以多啲積分 ❤️

reviews.text: I've recently discovered this brand and bought several products from them, this one definitely doesn't disappoint! Leaves skin smooth and smells nice. As I love mango in every form, of course I had to choose this one and I love it!
reviews.zh: 我最近先發現呢個品牌，買咗好幾款佢哋嘅產品，呢款絕對冇令我失望！令皮膚滑，聞落又好香。我鍾意所有形式嘅芒果，所以當然要揀呢款，我好鍾意！

reviews.text: I love the smell of peach and almost any time I see a product that boasts peach scents, I'll get it. Really excited that this version of peach is for sensitive skin so it's a double win. The texture is beautiful. It whipped up into the perfect, thick, soft foam and smelled like a spring peach blossom with a hint of peach fruit. My dry skin was clean but not stripped and all of my actives and products went on so perfectly afterward. Skin still feels dewy and bouncy almost two hours later. I'm really interested now in trying the Shea Butter version and may try it when I'm close to running out. Definitely a repurchase for me.
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意桃子味，每次見到有桃子香味嘅產品，我都會買。好開心呢款桃子版本係為敏感皮膚而設，所以一舉兩得。質地好靚，打出嚟嘅係厚、軟、理想嘅泡沫，聞落似春天嘅桃花，帶少少真桃子果香。我嘅乾性皮膚潔淨咗，但冇被扯得太乾，之後塗其他有效成分同產品都好好。皮膚差唔多兩個鐘之後仍然好水潤、有彈性。我而家好想試吓乳木果油版本，等快用完嗰陣可能會試。一定會再買。

reviews.text: I got the mango scent and it smells pretty good. I love mango so I would definitely repurchase this if I'm in the market for a foaming cleanser again. I have dry and sensitive skin so generally looking for cream cleansers or oil cleansers which don't require a water based 2nd step (like the skin 1004).
reviews.zh: 我買咗芒果味，聞落幾好。我好鍾意芒果，所以如果我再需要泡沫潔面產品，一定會再買。我皮膚乾性同敏感，通常會揀奶霜型或者油性潔面，唔需要水性第二步（例如 skin 1004）。

reviews.text:
well gosh darn, i think it washed my face.
it evidently left my face cleansed on multiple occasions, the texture is pleasant and it foams up to a almost cushy feeling. smells good too. I have sensitive skin with a dermal barrier that becomes irritated and damaged easily by many cleansers. I have been using this one for months and my skin has yet to suffer. a very good purchase.
reviews.zh:
哎呀，真係，我諗佢洗咗我面。
佢明顯將我面清潔咗好多次，質地好舒服，打出嚟嘅泡沫好似好軟熟咁。聞落都好好。我皮膚敏感，屏障容易因為好多潔面產品而受刺激同損傷。我用咗呢款幾個月，皮膚都仲未有問題。非常好嘅購買。

reviews.text: This cleansing foam is gentle for everyday use and I normally use it for mornings on its own. At nights, I use it as part of my double cleansing routine. It doesn't have any chemical / perfumey smell, feels mild on skin
reviews.zh: 呢款潔面泡沫日常用好溫和，我通常朝早自己單獨用。晚上就會當做雙重潔面嘅一部分用。佢冇化學味或者香水味，對皮膚感覺溫和。

reviews.text: I love the smell, texture and the way it leaves my skin feeling after I rinse it off! It smells so nice! Not drying at all. It sems to get my sunscreen off fine (I don't double cleanse unless I am wearing heavy makeup).
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意味道、質地，同埋沖走之後皮膚嗰種感覺！好好聞！完全唔乾。佢似乎可以清走防曬，我唔係雙重潔面，除非我化咗好濃嘅妝。

reviews.text: Super dense formula, a thick creamy product, a small amount is enough to wash whole face and neck (half the amount you would use with common gel cleansers). Super foaming but incredibly gentle. Zero stripping, a mild moisturizing effect. I am so impressed. Acai Berry is to fight saggy skin and gain elasticity. There is a coconut one for dry skin, gloss and hydration and a mango one for oily skin and pore purification. This one is so good I want now to try the mango one (I am combo skin).
reviews.zh: 質地好濃密，係厚身嘅乳霜，只需要少少份量就夠用嚟洗成張面同頸（只係一般啫喱潔面產品用量嘅一半）。泡沫好多，但係極之温和。完全唔會帶走皮膚嘅油分，有輕微保濕效果。我好驚喜。Acai Berry 係用嚟對抗鬆弛皮膚，增加彈性。有椰子版本適合乾性皮膚，有光澤同補水；芒果版本適合油性皮膚，深層清潔毛孔。呢款好好，我而家都想試吓芒果版（我係混合皮膚）。

note: 以下評價由 YesStyle 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
